title: Sagalee Ulfaatina Sobaa Faallaa
intro: Lafa miizaanni itti garagalfamee fi safartuun itti gabaabfame keessatti daldaltootaa fi daldaltoota gidduutti lubbuun amanamtuu guddatte. Namni dhuunfaa kun kophaa isaa amanamummaa dhabuu saba guutuu dura dhaabbatee, gara haqummaa fi waaqeffannaa Waaqa Dhugaa Tokkichaatti isaan waama ture. Ergaan ifa ta’ee fi waamichi haqa qabeessa ta’us, ummanni dhaggeeffachuu didee hiree hamaa isa mudate. Ergamaa kabajamaa kana Qur'aana irraa adda baasuu dandeessaa?
clues: Ummata jireenyi isaa daldalaa fi daldala irratti naanna'utti ergamaa ta'ee ergame.
Sabni koo guutummaa biyyattii keessatti safartuu gabaabaa kennuu fi ulfaatina gowwoomsuun beekama ture.
Akkasumas imaltoota karaa irratti shororkeessuun malaammaltummaa lafa guutuutti babal’isan.
Rabbiin qofa akka gabbaranii fi walitti dhufeenya namoota biroo wajjin qaban keessatti guutummaatti amanamoo akka ta’an isaan dhaama ture.
Ergaa kiyya didanii ana fi warra na waliin amanan lafa irraa ari'a jedhanii doorsisan.
Rabbiin rahmata Isaatiin anaa fi hordoftoota kiyya kan fayyise yoo ta’u, warri badii hojjetan ammoo adabbii hamaadhaan qabamaniiru.

outcome.label: Xumura Isaanii
options: Lolaan guddaan tokko hunda isaanii bishaaniin liqimse
Dhagaan suphee bishaanitti makame isaan irratti roobe

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًۭا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَـٰرِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ
verse: And when Our command came, We saved Shuʿayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone (11:94)
